subject: english
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: Meenakshi, a former councilior, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.
Meenakshi, a former councelor, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.
Meenakshi, a former councillor, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.
Meenakshi, a former counciler, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Meenakshi, a former councillor, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given sentences the sentence that contain all the correct spellings is* 'Meenakshi, a former councillor, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections.'*
 
• In all the sentences '**councillor**' is incorrectly spelt except for the **3rd option.**
 
• It means **'A member of a council, a group of people elected or appointed to make decisions or give advice'.** (परिषद का सदस्य) 
 
 
• *Example: He has sworn a privy **councillor**, and made Governor of the Island in** January 1780.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Meenakshi, a former councillor, is aspiring for a ticket to contest the elections. *
